findings.location: HTML poem, second stanza, first line
findings.source_quote: I’m a little bit shallow, I admit,
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «کچھ تنگ نظر ہوں میں» with «مانتی ہوں، کچھ سطحی ہوں» to convey “shallow” in the context of self-focus without changing it to “narrow-minded.”
findings.translation_quote: مانتی ہوں، کچھ تنگ نظر ہوں میں،

findings.location: HTML poem, first stanza, second line
findings.source_quote: What kind of vessel will I be:
findings.suggested_fix: Use the feminine form «میں کیسا برتن بنوں گی:» for consistency with the speaker’s feminine «مانتی ہوں» later in the poem.
